learning_outcomes.text: Explain the postulates of quantum mechanics
Understand basic concepts such as particle-wave duality, uncertainty principle, exclusion principle and quantum entanglement

syllabus_topics: Classical mechanics summary. Hamilton equations and Poisson brackets.
History of quantum Mechanics. Theories of light. Black-body radiation. Photoelectric effect. Atomic models.
Mathematical background. Complex numbers. Theory of probabilities. Vector spaces on the complex field. "bra" and "ket" notation.
Quantum mechanics postulates. Time evolution of the quantum state. Schrödinger and Heisenberg pictures.
Systems of two spins combined. Quantum entanglement.
assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.2 from on-line quizzes and 0.8 from a written quiz. Eligibility for quizzes requires attending at least 4 of the 6 lectures. Students can take a second written quiz to improve their 'written quiz' component grade. Electronic devices are strictly forbidden during quizzes, except for allowed calculators or special cases.
